evidence.evidence: In order to develop an accurate and user-friendly spam filter, in this paper, we propose a SOcial network Aided Personalized and effective spam filter (SOAP).
Experimental results show that SOAP can greatly improve the performance of Bayesian spam filters in terms of the accuracy, attack-resilience and efficiency of spam detection.
We also find that the performance of Bayesian spam filters is the lower bound of SOAP.

contribution.concept: Improved performance of Bayesian spam filters
